subject: S11 review: CHANGES REQUIRED
body:
S11 REVIEW: CHANGES REQUIRED

Reviewed tree: claude/naadi-shared at 1508098 (contains fe44ae6 + 7191c3c). No code edited. Provider keys blank; LLM mocked.

## What I ran (local stack: pg-rev11 :54492, st-rev11 :54592, auth-rev11 :54493; E2E_PORT=7992)
- Generator golden: tests/plan/test_generator.py 177 passed (incl. test_reference_inputs_reproduce_the_csv_byte_for_byte). My own diff: to_csv(generate(reference)) vs data/study_plan_step1_60d.csv -> `cmp` identical, sha256 f380ae1d…a0fa0ab on both, 17667 bytes. PASS.
- Generator edge probe (my script): 21 days OK; 20 -> too_few_study_days 422; 22, 90, 181 days OK; 1 h, 4 h, 14 h OK; Mon–Fri and Sat-only over 200 d OK; exam eve on a non-study weekday -> rest day still on E−1; leap-year span OK; same-day/1-day refused. Invariants held: day 1, all assessments, order, dates in range, study weekdays only. No upper bound on length (see D1).
- Unit (pytest not live/not db): 822 passed. Lint (biome + ruff + format): clean. Typecheck (tsc + mypy): clean. Vitest: web 254 + packages all passed. gen:contracts + gen:requirements: no drift (git status clean).
- db suite, fresh stack: 349 passed + 17 errors, all in tests/embeddings (fastembed models not cached in this container, S07 environment, not S11). After `embeddings prefetch`, full rerun: 365 passed, 1 skipped (perf test needs a reindexed corpus). S11 db tests (tests/plan, rls, live_check): 137 passed.
- Seed: `scripts/seed.py --data ../../data` OK (1769 changes, 0 unresolved sources).
- e2e smoke, today.spec + shell.spec, webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440, --retries=0 --workers=2: 84/84 passed twice (3.5 m, 3.2 m). This covers onboarding under 3 min, lime count 1, warm Today p95 < 1.5 s, offline, axe, and prod CSP with zero console errors.
- API probes (my db-marked script against the real app + seeded DB): diagnostic = 40, timed, purpose diagnostic, 0 mocks, difficulty 14/19/7, per-system counts close to the weight midpoints (multi-tagged questions push Multisystem 3.9→6 and Cardio 3.5→5, acceptable). No answer/explanation/why keys in the /api/diagnostic or /api/today JSON. Concurrency and far-future exam dates fail (D1, D3).
- Coach probe (my script, mocked gateway): one `structured` call, purpose `job`, user_id set; an invented digit ("37%", "99") is dropped; all dropped -> rules; BudgetExhausted -> rules for the rest of the pass with no further calls. Spelled-out numbers get through (D2).
- RLS (0013): study_plans select only; study_plan_days update(status, score_notes); coach_suggestions update(status); composite FKs (plan_id, user_id); four _own policies per table. OK.
- Readiness: first graded attempts in 60 d, blueprint midpoints, null until ≥ 40 answered and ≥ 50 % of the weight covered; coverage shown; no pass wording (the board's "Likely to pass" was correctly left out). OK.
- Screens (my run, test-results/screens/11, 40 shots) checked against Main/PhoneToday/Onboarding: layout, violet coach card, amber+"weak", "not enough data", check icons on chips. Only the small points in D6/D7.
- CI matrix: latest completed run with S11 = #130 (43981262307, sha 511fc4d). lint/typecheck/unit/drift/build GREEN; db GREEN; e2e chromium 719 passed / 18 failed, firefox 736 / 1, webkit 767 / 1. today.spec and shell.spec green in all 18 projects. The failures are NOT S11: chromium = S12b ink-sync.spec :238/:291/:366 × 6 projects; firefox-phone-390 = S08 qbank.spec:323 (axe target-size on the Lab values sheet's Close button); webkit-ipad-portrait = S08/S10 qbank.spec:431 (aborted /api/cards/stats fetch from the Builder logged as a pageerror). Runs 131–134 were still in progress.

## Defects

1. **D1 — Major — no upper bound on exam_date: unbounded plans and a cheap CPU/DB denial of service.**
   Repro: PUT /api/onboarding with exam_date "2099-12-31" (otherwise valid). Also GET /api/plan/preview?exam=step1&exam_date=2999-12-31&daily_hours=10&study_days=1..7.
   Expected: a 422 (e.g. `exam_date_too_far`) past a configured horizon. The brief's property range is n ∈ [21, 180].
   Actual: 200 after 12.0 s, writing 26,707 study_plan_days (26,647 of them copies of "Review") and 80,168 plan_items for one student. The preview spends 7.3 s of CPU per call, and it is the live endpoint the form calls while the student edits, so it is repeatable within the plan_read rate limit on the free Space.
   Fix: add `app_config.plan.max_study_days` (or max days to the exam, e.g. 180–365). Enforce it in OnboardingIn/preview before generating (PlanError `too_many_days` → structured 422 + ui_copy), set `max` on the date input, and add tests at the limit and one day past it.

2. **D2 — Major — the coach's number check lets invented numbers through when they are written as words.**
   Repro: a mocked gateway returns {"suggestions":[{"kind":"review_misses","title":"Misses","body":"You missed twelve questions this week, triple last week."}]} with facts {misses: 9, days: 7, questions: 9}. `word()` keeps it as source "llm". `numbers_ok` is also True for "a hundred cards — double yesterday", "Do Q99 and a20 block" (digits after a letter are skipped by `(?<![\w.])`) and "block XL".
   Expected: every number in the text appears in facts, or the suggestion is dropped.
   Actual: only ASCII digit runs not preceded by a letter or dot are checked.
   Fix: in suggest.py, also match number words (zero–twenty, tens, hundred, thousand, half, double, twice, triple, dozen…) and reject any that is not in facts. Simplest is to drop any suggestion containing one. Remove the letter lookbehind (or match `\d+` anywhere). Add unit cases for each pattern above.

3. **D3 — Medium — the diagnostic is not idempotent under concurrency.**
   Repro: 4 concurrent POST /api/diagnostic for one onboarded student (double tap, retry, two tabs).
   Expected: one block. The others get 200 with the same block_id.
   Actual: 4 × 201, 4 distinct open diagnostic blocks in `blocks`. The read-then-create runs in separate transactions with no lock or unique key.
   Fix: take `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('diagnostic:'||user_id))` around check+create in one transaction, or add a partial unique index on blocks(user_id) where config->>'purpose'='diagnostic' and finished_at is null (in a new migration, since 0013 is shipped) and return the existing row on conflict. Add a db test with concurrent requests.

4. **D4 — Medium — "one LLM call per user per night" is not enforced across runs, and a transient rate limit ends LLM use for the whole night.**
   Repro (code): coach_pass/store deletes tonight's `new` rows and calls word() again on every run. A second cron fire, an admin's manual run or a retried pass makes another LLM call (+ retry) for every student. Separately, `except BudgetExhausted` treats `reason="rate_limited"` (rpm bucket; my probe confirms) the same as `daily_cap`: `stats.budget_spent = True` and every remaining student gets rules.
   Expected: at most one call (+ one retry) per student per local date. Stop the pass only when the job reserve is spent; wait or skip on rpm.
   Fix: skip the LLM for a student who already has an `llm` row, or a recorded attempt, for that for_date. Store an attempt marker if needed, or count the job's llm_usage rows by user_id + run date. Only set budget_spent when `exc.reason == "daily_cap"`; on rate_limited, sleep until the reset (bounded) or use rules for that student only. Add unit tests.

5. **D5 — Low — max_users_per_run starves everyone after the first 200 user_ids.**
   `_STUDENTS ... order by p.user_id limit %s` picks the same 200 students every night. Fix: order by last coached (e.g. min(max(created_at)) of coach_suggestions, nulls first) or rotate with an offset per night.

6. **D6 — Low — the onboarding copy promises adaptation the product does not do (decision: materials and the diagnostic do not reorder the plan; S16 rebalances).**
   `onboarding.materials_legend` "Naadi will plan around it" and `onboarding.next_diagnostic` "…so the plan starts from what you already know, not from page one." Fix: reword to what is true now (e.g. "Naadi links to what you use"; "a 40-question diagnostic shows where you stand").

7. **D7 — Low — a second lime element on Today.**
   The "Now" status chip on the current flow item is filled lime (today-coach screenshots), next to the lime CTA. The Main board has no lime chip. limeCount only counts a/button, so the test misses it. Fix: use a neutral or outlined chip with the word "Now" (and keep it non-colour-only), so lime is only the CTA.

8. **D8 — Low — small correctness/wording items.**
   (a) With daily_hours = 1 the rest day keeps the template's 2 h, more than the student's daily hours. Clamp it to min(template, H).
   (b) `today.readiness_caption` hard-codes "60 days" although `coach.readiness_days` is configurable. Pass {days}.
   (c) The client's direct `update(status)` grant on coach_suggestions lets a student set an accepted suggestion back to `new` and accept it again, which duplicates items (self-only). Restrict status transitions with a policy or trigger: no move back to `new`.
   (d) PUT /api/onboarding saves completed_at (as_user) before write_plan (as_service) in a separate transaction, so a failed plan write leaves onboarding "complete" with no plan. Write the plan first, or set completed_at after it.
   (e) Onboarding never asks for or derives the time zone (profile default Asia/Kolkata), so a student abroad can get a plan that starts on the wrong local day. Prefill from Intl and save with the onboarding PUT.

D1 and D2 block approval (D2 is the brief's explicit coach rule; D1 is an unbounded write/CPU path from a public form). D3 and D4 should go in the same rework. D5–D8 can follow.
